topic: Scientific Method and Classification of Matter
key_concepts: The scientific method is a way scientists answer questions and solve problems
A valid scientific problem can be solved experimentally
Observations can be qualitative or quantitative
Experiments include independent variables, dependent variables, and control groups
Elements are made of one type of atom while compounds contain two or more elements
The modern periodic table has 118 elements
Chemical symbols follow Berzelius rules using letters from element names
Some elements and compounds have important biological roles such as iodine for the thyroid
Mixtures can be homogeneous or heterogeneous and include suspensions and colloids
Simple distillation separates liquid mixtures by differences in boiling points
Pure substances have fixed boiling and melting temperatures
Solutions consist of a solute dissolved in a solvent and can be unsaturated, saturated, or
